$comment: #EXP-1638 (owner 2026-11-06): LONG-PRESS THE APP ICON ×2 (iOS `UIApplicationShortcutItem`s, Android launcher shortcuts; web and desktop have no app icon menu). Model = pure `appShortcuts` + `parseAppShortcut` (src/app-shortcuts.ts; iOS ExpCore `AppShortcuts.swift`, Android `domain/AppShortcuts.kt`), every mirror replays the `*Cases`. THE LIST: the three `statics` in order (`new-issue` = THE New issue page with its board picker, `new-chat` = THE composer on the Agent tab with the composer's own default agent row, `search` = THE Search page), then the most recent chats, newest first, with the share-targets.json direct-share filter (no chat that is an agent's own conversation, NO ENCRYPTED chat: a tree key or a sealed title never reaches the OS), so the list never exceeds `maxEntries` (the iOS Home Screen shows 4). A chat entry's title is the chat's display title, its icon `icons.chat`, its id `recentChatPrefix` + session id, and it opens that session (inbox-route.json session target). iOS sets the static ones in Info.plist (`UIApplicationShortcutItems`) and the recent ones as `shortcutItems` whenever the chats store changes; Android declares the static ones in `res/xml/shortcuts.xml` and publishes the recent ones as dynamic shortcuts (rank 0 first), next to the direct-share shortcuts it already publishes (share-targets.json; those keep their own ids, ranked after). Signed out, or an entry whose chat is gone: the app opens on its normal start screen. Multi-account: the shortcuts follow the ACTIVE account; switching accounts republishes them.  #EXP-1830 (owner 2026-11-14: a pinned Assistant shortcut resumed the app wherever it was; 'keep New issue + New chat + Search'): AGENT CHATS. After the statics come the CHAT ENTRIES, in this order, deduplicated by id, the whole list still capped at `maxEntries`: (1) the viewer's ASSISTANT (agent-settings.json `assistant`), id `agentPrefix` + its agent id, title = its name, icon `icons.assistant` (THE brand mark, never a stored icon), color null; (2) the viewer's PINS of kind session (sidebar Pinned order), (3) the recent chats newest first. A chat that is the viewer's own AGENT CONVERSATION (its `agentId` names an agent in `agents`) is the agent entry (`agentPrefix` + agentId, the agent's name, its icon (`icons.agent` when null) and color; its title is the agent's name, so it may be encrypted); a plain chat is a `recentChatPrefix` entry and never an encrypted one; an agent conversation whose agent is not in `agents` (another member's, deleted) is no entry. An `agent:` entry opens THE agent's conversation (the caller's DM, Android `agent-dm/{agentId}`, iOS the agent channel; none yet = the empty DM). ANDROID: every chat entry is a plain dynamic shortcut ranked 0.. in list order (the launcher shows the manifest statics first); the share-targets.json sharing shortcuts keep their ids and ranks after them, and their LAUNCHER intent now names their chat too (`share-agent:X` launches `agent:X`, `share-chat:Y` launches `recent-chat:Y`), so one dragged onto the home screen (a pinned shortcut) opens THAT chat; a shortcut already pinned is updated in place once (the publisher re-pushes every row on first run of this version). OPENING (#EXP-1830 BACK STACK, ×2, a long-press entry, a pinned shortcut, a home widget row, an App Intent alike; cold start and warm alike): the app drops whatever it was showing back to THE start screen (the Agent tab root; a held New issue draft keeps its guard), then pushes the target, so Back returns to the Agent tab and then leaves the app; the target already on top is not pushed twice. Android: `singleTask` + `onNewIntent` deliver it, a redelivered (recreated) intent is never re-run. iOS: the scene's `shortcutItem` on connect and `windowScene(_:performActionFor:)` warm. Copy and icons are the app's own; no new component.

listCases.name: statics, then the Assistant, capped at maxEntries
no Assistant yet: pins first, then the newest chat
an agent conversation is the agent entry, encrypted or not; an unknown agent and an encrypted plain chat are none

parseCases.name: an agent chat without an id
a recent chat without an id
a direct-share id is not an app shortcut

chatEntryCases.name: Assistant, pins in pin order, then recent newest first, deduplicated

a sharing chat shortcut launches its chat
